Your child doesn’t need to get it “Right” on day one!

The first class can come with a lot of questions, Will they participate? Will they follow the activities? Are they actually learning if they seem distracted?

The 'Mistake' We Actually Encourage at Tickle Right!

We all want our kids to be the "perfect" example. Turns out, that can be a wrong goal. 

The surprising benefits of letting kids make mistakes, not the dangerous kind, but the everyday kind.

Letting kids self correct through daily life skills teaches cause and effect, and builds the kind of self trust no amount of "doing it for them" ever could.

Next time your child tries to take up a task, that might be exactly the moment to let them do it! Even if they make a mess out of it!
